maya: Heads-up: planning to promote model v4-int4-cascade to canary (~1% traffic) tomorrow 10:00 PST. Need to confirm promote thresholds + auto-fallback cascade. Quick take?
jon: Sounds good. What's current smoke metrics vs baseline? latency, exact-match, MRR?
sophia: Quick summary from staging run? short-docs / long-docs / safety slices?
maya: Smoke on staging: +0.7% MRR on short-docs, latency p50 +3ms, p99 +12ms. But hallucination short-answer test shows +0.9% regress vs baseline. We need a clear decision rule before promoting.
jon: For canary gating I'd require both a statistical test and absolute delta: e.g., p-value < 0.05 for MRR gain AND delta > 0.4% sustained. For regressions, absolute delta > 0.5% on any safety slice -> autofallback.
sophia: Agree on the safety slice rule. Also suggest z-score monitoring for noisy signals (z>3 to mark significant). If hallucination delta > 0.5% AND z>3 -> immediate fallback.
lee: Also propose a two-step cascade: first fallback to sibling quant (int8) for affected slices, if still bad then fallback to v3-fp16. Policy proto: `cascade=["int8-sibling","v3-fp16"]`, `grace_period=10m`, `required_samples=2000`
arjun: Would prefer rolling-window z-score (10m window) rather than single test to reduce false positives.
sophia: Rollup: trigger when (z>3 AND delta>0.5%) on a monitored slice OR when absolute regression breaches 1% on any critical slice. For promotions require sustained MRR gain >0.4% for 90m with p<0.05 and latency_p99 within 15% of baseline.
deploy-bot: Canary started: v4-int4-cascade @ 1% traffic at 2026-03-24T10:00:00Z (id: canary-4401234567).
jon: I'll wire alerts for `hallucination_rate`, `mrr_short`, `latency_p99`, `entropy_drop`. Alert rule: (delta > 0.5%) OR (z > 3) -> mark candidate unhealthy. Add a secondary check to mute first 30m due to cache warmup.
maya: For rollout sequencing: staging -> 1% canary -> 10% shadow/promote gating -> 10% live if conditions meet, then gradual ramp. Exclude first 30m from gating or require >2000 cache-hit samples as lee suggested.
lee: Implementation note: KV-cache warmup skews early metrics. Excluding 30m or requiring min cache hits is necessary. Also add synthetic QA runs every 15m to surface factuals.
arjun: I'll add a small synthetic test set and an hourly short-answer suite to the monitoring pipeline; those run against both candidate and baseline.
sophia: Action items: jon -> alerts/dashboards; lee -> implement cascade policy config + grace logic; arjun -> synthetic suite; maya -> coordinate promote and notify eng-oncall for any fallback. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Fallback executed: switched 0.7% traffic to int8-sibling at 2026-03-24T10:42:15Z due to hallucination_rate delta 0.92% (z=3.4).
maya: Thanks — dropping canary to 0.2% and re-running targeted smoke with adjusted quant params. Will open a follow-up thread/postmortem if tuning doesn't resolve.
